What it shows the buyer: What the product is, in one look
How to take it: Whole product, centred, on a plain light background. Leave space on every side. Daylight, phone level, 1x lens.
Etsy tip: This is the search thumbnail. Shoot it landscape or square, and leave a border so Etsy can crop it to square, portrait and landscape without cutting the product.
Shopify tip: Shoot it square. Use the same shape for every photo so the gallery does not jump.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Ribbed ceramic vase in sand, front view, white background, space all round

How to take it: Same background and distance as shot 1. Turn the product, or shoot from a three-quarter angle.
Etsy tip: Use the same background as shot 1 so the set looks like one listing.
Shopify tip: Same light and crop as shot 1.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Vase from the side, showing the ribbed shape

How to take it: Product in a hand, or next to an object everyone knows (a mug, a book, a phone). Do not use a coin only.
Etsy tip: Buyers often message to ask about size. This photo answers before they ask.
Shopify tip: Put the real size in the description too. A photo is not a measurement.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Vase held in one hand, next to a coffee mug

How to take it: Product on a plain background with height, width and depth written beside it, in cm and inches. Keep the text short.
Etsy tip: Never put text on the first photo. Shots 2 onward can carry numbers.
Shopify tip: Make the text big enough to read on a phone.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Vase with lines: 22 cm (8.7 in) tall, 12 cm (4.7 in) wide

How to take it: Get close in daylight. Focus on one detail. Colour on screen must match the product in your hand.
Etsy tip: Etsy suggests at least 2000 pixels on each side, so close-ups stay sharp when buyers zoom.
Shopify tip: Shopify zoom works on bigger photos. 2048 x 2048 is a common square size.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Close-up of the speckled glaze and the ribs

What it shows the buyer: Every colour, size or style you sell
How to take it: All options side by side, same light and angle. Then one photo of each option alone.
Etsy tip: Link each option photo to its variation (Variations > Link photos).
Shopify tip: Give each variant its own image so the photo changes when the buyer picks it.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Sand, sage and charcoal vases in a row, then one photo of each

What it shows the buyer: How it looks in a real home or on a person
How to take it: Product in a real setting, used the way the buyer will use it. Keep the rest of the scene calm and simple.
Etsy tip: Use it as shot 2 or 3 if your product is about style or mood.
Shopify tip: Good for the second photo in the gallery and for collection banners.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Vase with dried grass on a wooden shelf, next to two books

How to take it: Lay out every item that ships: product, parts, extras, care card. Shoot from above.
Etsy tip: Stops 'does it come with...' questions and wrong expectations.
Shopify tip: Match the 'In the box' line in your description.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Vase, felt pad and care card laid flat

How to take it: The packed item: box, wrapping, gift note if you offer one. Show only what every buyer gets.
Etsy tip: Gift buyers look for this. If gift wrap costs extra, say so in the listing.
Shopify tip: Use it on gift collections and in the product gallery.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Vase in its kraft box with tissue paper

Shot: Made by hand or personal touch
What it shows the buyer: How it is made or what can be personalized
How to take it: Hands at work, the workspace, or a proof of the personalization. Real photos only.
Etsy tip: Shows who made it. If it is made after the order comes in, say made to order in the listing too.
Shopify tip: Good for brand pages and the last gallery photo.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Hands shaping the vase on the wheel

What it shows the buyer: The product moving or in use
How to take it: Turn the product slowly or show it in use. No sound needed.
Etsy tip: Etsy allows 2 videos, 5 to 15 seconds, and removes the sound.
Shopify tip: Shopify accepts MP4 or MOV product videos. Keep it short and show the product in the first second.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): 8-second turn of the vase on a table
